research_updates.notes: Source families checked: IM3 coordinates/footprint, Microsoft releases, Grant County assessor address/owner search, Ecology SEPA and current/rescinded air orders, City agreements and parcel identifiers. research_updates.title: Direct discovery — real-property fiscal account
research_updates.notes: Source families checked: Grant County Assessor/Treasurer owner, parcel, value, improvement, statement and payment pages. Query/identifier: owner Microsoft; account 72793; parcel 313769000; 1515 NW Port Industrial Parkway; tax/appraisal years 2014-2026. Result: useful. Eight positive annual appraised-value stocks and five fully paid real-property tax statements are retained. The portal's owner query returned ten distinct Microsoft real/personal accounts, including separate Columbia, MWH, M Street and Road S properties. The account is campus-wide, so it is not divided by footprint or improvement count; appraised value is not investment, and payment is not net fiscal benefit.

research_updates.title: Adversarial continuation — metric and model disposition ledger
research_updates.notes: Initial pass record disposition: Investment — retain the existing $31 million city-owned reuse infrastructure actual at supporting-infrastructure scope; retain the $4,807,473 mixed-campus PUD agreement only as a source projection; reject assessed value, the overlapping Oxford estimate and broader regional claims as investment. Construction — rejected: no selected-building permit value, expenditure, workers, hours or payroll. Operations — rejected: no selected-building/campus realized employees, payroll or revenue; regional jobs/wages are unallocated. Suppliers — rejected: no payment, vendor-location or local-retention bounds. Fiscal — retain separate campus real/personal assessed values and paid-tax series; reject regional overlapping tax totals, selected-building allocation, incentive value and netting. Public costs — rejected in this initial handoff: no same-scope marginal service, infrastructure, debt-service or administrative cost had yet been retained. Community — retain the unallocated recipient-confirmed $25,000 gift; reject allocation and aggregation with broader totals. Resources — retain 117 campus permit-listed generators; reject actual generator use/emissions and selected-building electricity/water/waste observations. County employment — causal and descriptive models rejected because the corrected MWH treatment is phased/unknown at building level, Columbia predates it and multiple operators/concurrent expansions confound attribution. County wages — rejected for the same timing/counterfactual defects and no worker-residence bridge. County GDP — rejected for the same defects; Microsoft's $269 million figure is a source-reported regional impact, not an observed project contribution. Last-resort models considered and rejected in the initial handoff: assessor-value-to-investment conversion, tax-share allocation by floor area, tax-equal public-cost break-even, utility capacity/annual-use conversion, generator capacity/runtime, construction job-years/payroll, supplier multiplier, community proxy, and county comparison gaps. Initial modeled additions: zero. Handoff remains candidate_pending_adversarial_review; this initial discovery-plus-gap-closure account is provisional and never accepted. No records requests were made.

research_updates.title: Corrective adversarial continuation — final metric and model ledger
research_updates.notes: Corrective disposition after reopening every mandated family. Investment — retain the existing $31 million reuse-system actual, the three newly normalized City Fund 450 outflows at supporting-infrastructure scope, and the $4,807,473 mixed-campus PUD agreement only as a projection; reject assessed-value conversion, regional impact totals, bond proceeds, overlapping Oxford estimate and any public/private reuse split. Construction jobs/payroll — reject: no selected-building spend, hours, worker count, job-years or payroll; the Fund 450 outlays mix capital, debt, operating and transfers. Operations jobs/payroll — reject: 377 jobs and $93,000 average compensation are three-county portfolio claims and no MWH headcount/payroll or worker-residence bridge exists. Suppliers/local spend — reject: no private payment ledger, verified vendor geography or local-purchase share. Fiscal/incentives/net/public costs — retain separate direct paid-tax series and add exact real-plus-personal campus aggregates for complete 2022-2025 tax years; add a 2025 equal-cost break-even threshold only as a policy-authorized identity. Reject selected-building allocation, incomplete 2026 combination, company/facility incentive amount, net fiscal claim and annual marginal service-cost estimate. City Oxford outlays are historical infrastructure observations, not recurring cost or subsidy incidence. Community — retain the unallocated $25,000 BBCC gift; QSD partnership, broader operator totals and rebate-funded recipients have no compatible cash/allocation bridge. Electric/water/wastewater/reuse — retain existing broad infrastructure and connection context only; reject use, bill, load, rate and public/private split models. Generators/emissions — retain 117 permit-listed generators; reject legal fuel/runtime/emission ceilings as actual performance and reject bounded energy/emissions conversion. County employment, wages and GDP — reject all three comparison-gap models: the governed first-entry assessment for FIPS 53025 is candidate_events_not_first_entry, first_entry_verified false and inventory_completeness_status not_established; the 2007 event has only six pre-periods and is excluded, while the selected MWH building has no exact treatment date and Grant already contained Microsoft Columbia and other data centers. Model tally: retain/add four annual study.modeled_combined_property_tax_paid estimates for 2022-2025 and one study.modeled_annual_local_service_cost_break_even estimate for 2025; reject assessor-to-investment, footprint tax allocation, county comparison gaps, generator energy/emissions, reuse public/private split, construction job-year/payroll, operations payroll and supplier/local-spend models. Project description remains the single boundary-corrected description from the initial pass because no new source changes it. Handoff remains candidate_pending_adversarial_review; neither commit is an accepted project. No records requests were made.

research_updates.title: Third corrective audit — Central Washington operations and source-model method
research_updates.notes: The 2025 Central Washington impact report and its methods page were reopened at page level. EY QUEST performed the analysis with IMPLAN regional input-output tables; Microsoft supplied construction, operations, tax and headcount inputs. Direct, indirect and induced channels are defined; most job and tax-effect outputs are modeled, while selected direct employee and contractor counts are company-provided. Labor income includes wages, salaries and benefits. It uses the directly observed property-tax bill without estimating actual public cost, cash collections, recipient distributions or net fiscal impact. The only retained synthesis is an exact same-account FY2026 assessed-liability public-service-cost break-even identity. It uses the directly observed four-quarter real-property bill without estimating actual public cost, cash collections, recipient distributions or net fiscal impact. Investment, construction, supplier, operations, fiscal-net, resource, community and each GDP, employment and wage candidate are rejected separately in the evidence fragment because compatible inputs, scope alignment, non-overlap proof or credible identification are unavailable. prj_study_im3_building_00300974499: Corrective policy-1.3.0 synthesis. Three legacy combined real-and-personal-property FTZ counterfactuals are superseded by narrower business-personal-property-only estimates because the Apple BPP account directly exhibits the 5% assessment ratio while the real-property account has a different valuation base. The replacements hold observed effective tax rates and full cash value constant and isolate only the assessment-ratio component; they are not cash grants, audited forgone-revenue amounts or net fiscal benefits. All other legacy Apple Mesa estimates fail the direct-evidence, scope, time-profile, geography or decision-relevance gates and are marked for removal in the evidence fragment. prj_study_im3_building_00359930465: Post-fifth-pass last-resort modeling gate for Equinix Seattle SE3 retains eight bounded syntheses. Construction is represented separately by the AGC/DJC $50 million-$100 million award-category sensitivity and a 50,482-hours wage benchmark; neither is audited spend or certified payroll. Opening evidence for 24-hour operations and security supports only a conditional one-active-post coverage floor and wage-cost benchmark, not observed posts, headcount, payroll or total staffing. The 2011 lease's up-to-9-MW allocation remains a 25/50/100-percent throughput sensitivity, with separate statewide/tariff price and eGRID NWPP location-based emissions benchmarks that are not bills, measured emissions or market-based results. A medium-confidence identity sets the 2026 same-account assessed-liability public-service-cost break-even threshold equal to the exact landlord-parcel bill; it does not estimate actual public cost, tenant pass-through, cash receipt, recipient distribution or net fiscal impact. A supplier/non-labor residual is rejected because the award category does not define cost coverage and the reported hours do not establish complete labor coverage; community and causal county-effect candidates still fail for lack of compatible inputs or identification. prj_study_im3_building_00364289074: Corrective residual modeled account for Microsoft San Antonio. Eight transferred construction, labor, procurement, operating, and household-output scenarios were removed because their arbitrary capital shares, forecast-realization cases, local-purchase assumptions, and Virginia coefficients were not bounded by project observations. Only three low-confidence descriptive county comparisons remain: each uses the project's documented operating-by 2013 anchor and official Bexar County outcome data, has a finite fit-sensitivity envelope, and explicitly makes no causal attribution. The account intentionally remains incomplete because no defensible direct observation or residual model closes the supplier category. prj_study_im3_building_00377585075: Corrective DET01 synthesis. Only exact same-period tax-account arithmetic, its explicitly conditional public-cost break-even identity and a unit conversion of displayed municipal meter history remain. Construction, employment, supplier, household, electricity, cooling, emissions, wastewater and county-effect models were removed because the audit did not bound the missing project inputs. This account is intentionally incomplete where direct evidence remains unbounded. prj_study_im3_building_00388148510: Project-scoped modeled synthesis for TierPoint Little Rock. Eleven resolved-year real-property taxable values are multiplied by signed code 03/33 school, city, and county millage components; 2025 is excluded because its observed Amount Due does not disclose the underlying revised taxable value.
